entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A ronin samurai, kanji magician and con artist from Kamigawa who played a key role in ending the Kami War.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: An ogre shaman who allies with Toshi in the Hyozan Reckoners and later merges with the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: An allegiance of Toshi and Hidetsugu bound by an oath, later joined by Kobo, Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer.

entities.name: Boss Uramon
entities.description: A crime boss in Numai whose hitmen included Toshi, and who owned the Shadow Gate.

entities.name: Kobo
entities.description: Hidetsugu's apprentice and former budoka, murdered by Choryu in Jukai.

entities.name: Choryu
entities.description: A Minamo agent who killed Kobo and was later sent to Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Princess Michiko Konda
entities.description: Daughter of the daimyo Konda who merges with the spirit Kyodai to become the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Michiko's father, whose crime caused the Kami War; turned to stone and shattered by Kyodai.

entities.name: Mochi
aliases: the Smiling Kami of Crescent Moon
entities.description: A kami who showed Michiko the night of her birth; torn apart by the oni's jaws.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: Kamigawa's patron kami of darkness and secrets who blessed Toshi with the Shadow Gate.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: A mahotsukai agent of Uramon who becomes a hyozan reckoner and Toshi's reluctant ally.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: A nezumi who joins the hyozan; Toshi ends his suffering with an axe.

entities.name: Chiyo
entities.description: A soratami leader who hunts Toshi and is destroyed by Night's Reach.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The spirit released from That Which Was Taken who merges with Michiko.

entities.name: Sisters of Flesh and Spirit
entities.description: Combined entity of Michiko and Kyodai who destroyed O-Kagachi and took his place.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: A dragon-turtle kami destroyed by the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit.

entities.name: All-Consuming Oni of Chaos
entities.description: An oni manifested by Hidetsugu's call.

entities.name: Shadow Gate
entities.description: Uramon's artifact allowing travel between shadows, later united with Toshi's body.

entities.name: That Which Was Taken
entities.description: A stone disk trapping Michiko's sister's spirit.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where the Kami War occurs.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war between kami and humans on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: City in the Takenuma swamp.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: Soratami academy where the climactic events occur.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: The moonfolk city above the academy, much of which Toshi's released oni-dog destroys.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane to which Toshi is transported.

entities.name: Clan Umezawa
entities.description: Clan founded by Toshi on Dominaria.

events.summary: Toshi, sent with Uramon's hitmen to attack Hidetsugu, convinces the ogre to form the Hyozan Reckoners.
events.quote: The ogre killed all the others, but the kanji mage managed to convince him to form an allegiance that became known as the Hyozan Reckoners

events.summary: Toshi accidentally interrupts a parley and defeats two soratami; Chiyo's party then waits at his home.
events.quote: The moonfolk tried to kill him, but he defeated them with the help of his kanji magic.

events.summary: Toshi and Kobo set out for Jukai and defeat minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage at Sokenzan.
events.quote: They crossed Sokenzan on their way, and successfully defeated the minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage .

events.summary: Kobo is killed by Choryu; Toshi rescues Michiko.
events.quote: When Toshi awoke, he found Kobo hung between two trees, his lungs filled with water, a victim of the Minamo agent Choryu .

events.summary: Mochi shows Michiko her birth night; Toshi accepts Night's Reach's blessings and defeats Life's Web, then sends Choryu to Hidetsugu.
events.quote: Toshi was able to defeat Life's Web using his kanji magic that had been greatly enhanced by Night's Reach.

events.summary: Pursuers are killed by the yuki-onna; Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer are forced to join the hyozan; the yuki-onna is imprisoned in a tile.
events.quote: The yuki-onna was then imprisoned inside a tile.

events.summary: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer turn on Uramon; Toshi steals the Shadow Gate and is united with it by Night's Reach.
events.quote: When Uramon ordered Toshi's death, both of the new hyozan turned on their former lord.

events.summary: Toshi defeats Chiyo and releases the oni-dog, which destroys much of Otawara.
events.quote: He fought and defeated Chiyo, then released Hidetsugu's oni-dog from the tile to destroy much of Otawara.

events.summary: Toshi steals Konda's stone trophy and escapes the hyozan oath with Night's Reach's help.
events.quote: With the Myojin of Night's Reach's help, Toshi was able to escape the bonds of the hyozan oath.

events.summary: Toshi lifts the curse from Kiku, who then agrees to help him.
events.quote: Toshi removed the curse, leading to a night of strange passion between the two.

events.summary: Hidetsugu chokes Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and invokes the oath's wrath.
events.quote: Marrow-Gnawer managed to stab the ogre's eye, freeing Toshi and Kiku but invoking the wrath of the oath upon himself.

events.summary: Toshi stabs Hidetsugu through the remaining eye; the All-Consuming and O-Kagachi clash and Hidetsugu is changed.
events.quote: Hidetsugu prevailed in the end, but Toshi used his victory gesture to stab him through the remaining eye from a shadow cast by Kiku's body.

events.summary: Toshi ends Marrow-Gnawer's suffering with an axe.
events.quote: The ronin was, however, unable to save Marrow-Gnawer from the curse and so ended the nezumi's suffering with an axe.

events.summary: Toshi frees the yuki-onna from the kanji binding her.
events.quote: Toshi then released the yuki-onna and returned to Jukai.

events.summary: Toshi escapes with the disk through the shadows against the myojin's wish; the disk punctures her mask, and he loses her blessings and his kanji abilities.
events.quote: She fled and Toshi was spat out of the shadows bereft of the myojin's blessings and even his kanji abilities.

events.summary: Michiko touches the disk, releasing Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit, destroy O-Kagachi and take his place.
events.quote: Together, they destroyed O-Kagachi and took his place.

events.summary: Kyodai turns Konda to stone and shatters him; Hidetsugu emerges merged with the oni and Mochi is eaten.
events.quote: Mochi was torn apart and eaten by the oni's jaws.

events.summary: Chiyo stabs Toshi; Night's Reach forgives him and Chiyo is destroyed.
events.quote: Once more, Toshi swore his allegiance to her and so Chiyo was destroyed.

events.summary: Toshi is transported to Dominaria, blinded, and becomes the first of Clan Umezawa.
events.quote: As a parting gift, the myojin took his sight, leaving him blind.

relations.note: Formed the Hyozan Reckoners; later enemies.
relations.quote: the kanji mage managed to convince him to form an allegiance that became known as the Hyozan Reckoners
Once more, Toshi swore his allegiance to her and so Chiyo was destroyed.

relations.note: Kobo was found hung between two trees.
relations.quote: a victim of the Minamo agent Choryu .

relations.note: Mercy killing to end his suffering.
relations.quote: so ended the nezumi's suffering with an axe.

relations.note: Toshi was one of Uramon's hitmen.
relations.quote: Toshi became a member of Boss Uramon 's hitmen.
Kyodai confronted him and punished him for his crime by turning him into stone and shattering him

relations.note: Her 'sister' spirit, merged into one entity.
relations.quote: Michiko and Kyodai then merged into a new combined entity, the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit .
